sources.cite: Emerson, Rosemount 3051 Pressure Transmitter with HART Protocol, reference manual 00809-0100-4007 rev. BA (2017): §3.5 integral manifolds, §4.3 LCD display, §6.4 disassembly and §6.5 reassembly procedures

manifold.name: Valve manifold
manifold.does: Bolted under the process flange: its valves isolate the transmitter from the process and equalise its two sides, so it can be zeroed or taken off in service.
manifold.material: Forged stainless steel body, valve stems and seats

process_flange.name: Process flange
process_flange.does: Brings the process pressure through two ports to the sensor module's isolating diaphragms; PTFE O-rings seal it to the module.

drain_vents.name: Drain/vent valves
drain_vents.does: Screwed into the process flange beside each port: opened to drain liquid or vent gas trapped in the flange chambers.

sensor_module.name: Sensor module
sensor_module.does: Turns the process pressure into an electrical signal: the isolating diaphragms pass it through the fill fluid to the sensing cell.
sensor_module.sealed_why: The sensor module is sealed and filled at the factory and is replaced as a unit, never opened in the field.

isolator.name: Isolating diaphragms
isolator.does: Thin corrugated diaphragms that meet the process and pass its pressure to the fill fluid; never scratched, punctured or pressed.

sensor_cell.name: Sensing cell
sensor_cell.does: A capacitance cell: the fill fluid moves its sensing diaphragm between two plates, and the change in capacitance measures the pressure.
sensor_cell.material: Silicone fill fluid, metal and ceramic cell

housing.name: Electronics housing
housing.does: Threaded onto the sensor module's neck; a wall divides it into the electronics compartment and the field terminal compartment, each with its cover.

cover_front.name: Electronics cover
cover_front.does: Screws onto the electronics side of the housing, metal to metal; its window shows the display.

window.name: Display window
window.does: The glass in the electronics cover through which the display is read.

cover_back.name: Terminal cover
cover_back.does: Screws onto the side marked "FIELD TERMINALS"; taken off to reach the wiring.

electronics.name: Electronics board
electronics.does: Linearises the sensor's signal and makes the 4–20 mA output and its HART signal; held in the housing by two captive screws.

display.name: LCD display
display.does: Shows the measured value; plugs onto the electronics board with a pin connector and can be turned in steps.

terminal_block.name: Terminal block
terminal_block.does: Where the loop wires land: the signal terminals and the test terminals; slides onto the housing's power posts, held by two screws.

cable_gland.name: Cable gland
cable_gland.does: Seals the loop cable where it enters the terminal compartment.
